response.justification: Bogdan is a solid, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with roughly 14-15 years of broad experience across web, embedded, and infrastructure, but the role requires a director-level AI strategy leader with recognized AI expertise, entrepreneurial experience at scale, and a track record of advising strategic customers on cloud/AI adoption. His experience is almost entirely hands-on individual contributor work with no evidence of AI/ML specialization, strategic advisory work, or executive-level influence, making him a weak match for this specialized principal-level strategic role.
strengths: Broad, deep engineering experience across many stacks and domains (web, embedded, infra) over ~15+ years
Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit as founder of an open-source platform (GISCollective) and startup-like ventures
Strong communicator and community contributor via talks, workshops, and open-source projects
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI-powered product development, despite the role's core focus
No evidence of strategic advisory, customer-facing, or director-level leadership experience
Career trajectory shows mostly individual contributor/senior developer roles rather than principal/strategic influence roles

key_factors.factor: No strategic/advisory or director-level leadership evidence
Long, versatile engineering tenure and entrepreneurial founder experience
